**Observation Log:**

- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Emaad retired from boxing a short time later, content in the knowledge that he had given everything he had to the sport he loved.

- [EVENT] Emaad realized he was 46 years old and had been losing matches recently, leading him to decide to retire from boxing.
- [EVENT] Shavez became the biggest boxer in the world, winning 7 Boxing World Cup trophies for Pakistan.
